comment_periods.title: West Shore Trail – Meeks Bay to D.L. Bliss State Park EA or EIS/EIR — scoping comment period
comment_periods.project_title: West Shore Trail – Meeks Bay to D.L. Bliss State Park
comment_periods.summary: TRPA and the County are preparing a joint Environmental Assessment or Environmental Impact Statement/Environmental Impact Report (EA or EIS /EIR) for the proposed West Shore Trail extension, a shared use path that would connect Meeks Bay and D.L. Bliss State Park. The joint document will serve as either an EA or an EIS prepared by TRPA in accordance with the TRPA Bi-State Compact, Code of Ordinances (Code), and Rules of Procedure, and as an EIR prepared by the County in accordance with the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) and the State CEQA Guidelines. This section of trail was first contemplated and studied in the State Route (SR) 89 Recreation Corridor Management Plan and Cascade to Meeks Trail Feasibility Study, which can be accessed at: https://www.trpa.gov/rtp/sr-89-recreation-corridor-management-plan/.
comment_periods.instructions: TRPA and El Dorado County are jointly preparing the environmental document. Submit written comments on its scope and content through the comment form on the TRPA website, by email to rcremeen@trpa.gov, or by mail to the TRPA senior planner at PO Box 5310, Stateline, NV 89449. Include "West Shore Trail – Meeks Bay to D.L. Bliss State Park EIS/EIR" in the subject line. Oral comments are also taken at the scoping open house on November 2, 2026, 5:30–7:00 PM, at the Tahoe City Public Utility District, 221 Fairway Drive, Tahoe City, and during public interest comment at the TRPA Advisory Planning Commission meeting on November 12, 2026.
